fields.name: Gopījanavallabha Dāsa (author of the Rasikamaṅgala)
fields.notes:
A Gopa of Dhāreṇḍā in Midnapore, the eldest of the five sons of Rasamaya; his brothers were Haricaraṇa Dāsa, Mādhava, Rasikānanda and Kiśora Dāsa, his uncles Vaṁśī and Mathurā Dāsa. He and all his family took dīkṣā from Rasikānanda Prabhu. One of the «aṣṭa-śiśu» who dressed as gopīs in the Rāsa festival at Gopīballabhpur (Rasikamaṅgala Paścima 2.45). He wrote the Rasikamaṅgala, the life of his guru.

The record «Gopijanavallabha Dāsa» #371 was the same person and was joined to this one (07-11-2026).

He was a disciple of Rasikānanda Prabhu; his surname was Maṅgarāja (Rasikamaṅgala Paścima 14.106). Taken out of the record «Haricandana» #462, which mixed several persons; the record «Mangaraja» #904 (the same verse) was joined to this one (07-11-2026).
